title: Denmark hails ‘binding’ Greenland deal with Trump

blocks.text: COPENHAGEN — Denmark on Saturday hailed a “binding” deal announced by US President Donald Trump to give Washington “permanent control” over Greenland’s security and bar Russian and Chinese bases from the Arctic territory.
